title: Linear and Nonlinear Instability in Two-Dimensional Inertial Magnetohydrodynamics
summary: We study spectral and nonlinear instability for some steady states of a two-dimensional inertial magnetohydrodynamic system on the torus. For equilibria with aligned velocity and magnetic fields, the linearized problem reduces to a matrix recurrence of Fourier coefficients, and a stable matrix continued fraction produces a smooth eigenmode. For a purely magnetic family, the square of the linearized operator admits a compact self-adjoint reduction on each transverse Fourier blocks that classifies the entire unstable spectrum.
